notes_md.md.essence: Design history and business rules for scratch‑pad; must consult this file before making changes.

eslint_config_js.md.essence: ESLint flat config for TypeScript React Vite — only lints `.ts/.tsx` files, ignores `dist/`, uses recommended presets. Edit with caution: flat format requires ESLint v9+.

SKILL_md.md.essence: Documentation for Scratch Pad markdown-to-shareable-URL service — API endpoint POST /api/url, 7-day TTL, localStorage persistence for named sheets.

README_md.md.essence: README documentation — describes architecture, API endpoints, and design decisions.

App_tsx.md.essence: Main App component for Markdown scratch pad with live preview, local storage, URL sharing, and auto-save — critical: auto-save skips when content loaded from URL and a named sheet exists, so don't break that logic.

ProseConfigPanel_tsx.md.essence: Controlled prose config panel with overlay dismissal and reset to defaults; expect `config` and `onChange` props, and renders nothing when `open` is false.

SheetsPanel_tsx.md.essence: Sheet panel component that refreshes list only on open; deletes with window.confirm and hard-navigates via window.location.href.

package_json.md.essence: Package config for a private React 19 scratch‑pad app (Vite/TS/Redis) — critical to preserve `"private": true` and `"type": "module"`.

main_tsx.md.essence: Entry point mounts React app into `#root`; critical: root element must exist.

tsconfig_json.md.essence: Root tsconfig delegating to sub-projects — never edit here; modify tsconfig.app.json or tsconfig.node.json instead.

tsconfig_app_json.md.essence: TypeScript config for `src/` with strict bundler‑style settings (`verbatimModuleSyntax`, `noEmit`, React JSX) – only modify if you know how these affect Vite's build.

storage_ts.md.essence: LocalStorage utility for scratch pad state — note `!important` CSS overrides and silent failure on storage full.

vercel_json.md.essence: Vercel rewrite config: routes `/api/*` to itself and everything else to `index.html` for SPA client-side routing — order matters.

tsconfig_node_json.md.essence: TSConfig for `vite.config.ts` only — strict, type-only checks; uses `verbatimModuleSyntax` and `erasableSyntaxOnly`; no enums/namespaces allowed; unused vars fail build; not used for app source.

types_ts.md.essence: Exports static types and constants (prose config, state, storage, fonts) for the scratch pad editor; editing any value here affects every component that imports from this module.

vite_config_ts.md.essence: Vite config file with React plugin; add all Vite configuration changes here.
